cv.name: Laia Vidal Torrent
cv.headline: Data Analyst | Former hotel revenue manager | SQL, Python, Looker
cv.summary: Data analyst who moved into analytics from hotel revenue management. After four years setting prices and forecasting demand for city hotels, I completed a data analytics master's and now work on marketplace analytics for a travel tech company.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Build Looker dashboards for supply and demand on a vacation-rental marketplace
Designed the analysis framework for pricing experiments with the product team
Wrote a Python forecasting model for weekly bookings with around 8% MAPE
Translate questions from commercial teams into SQL queries and clear recommendations

experience.title: Junior Data Analyst
bullets: Prepared campaign performance reports for retail clients in BigQuery and Looker Studio

experience.title: Revenue Manager
bullets: Set daily rates for three city hotels using demand forecasts and competitor data
Increased RevPAR by 9% year on year at the flagship property

education.degree: Master's in Data Science and Business Analytics
